instruction:
Start with /home/user/Desktop/revision_A.FCStd and /home/user/Desktop/revision_B.FCStd in FreeCAD 0.21.2 Path/CAM. To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH). At the start of the task, use `/usr/lib/freecad/bin/freecadcmd-python3` for FreeCAD Path command-line automation.

Compare the editable revision parameters and physical geometry: both are centered 120 x 80 x 18 mm plates using G54 at the plate XY center and bottom Z=0; Revision A has a centered 60 x 36 mm blind pocket to absolute Z=10 and four D6 blind holes at (-45,-26), (45,-26), (-45,26), and (45,26) mm to Z=4; Revision B changes the centered pocket to 72 x 44 mm at the same Z=10 floor and moves the four D6 holes to (-48,-28), (42,-28), (-48,24), and (42,24) mm at the same Z=4 floor. In the editable answer, preserve Revision B's part, pocket boundary, and hole records. Add one editable FeaturePython comparison record with this explicit schema: RecordRole (String, RevisionComparison); RevisionAFile and RevisionBFile (File); RevisionASHA256 and RevisionBSHA256 (String); PocketALength, PocketAWidth, PocketBLength, PocketBWidth, and PocketFloorZ (Length); HoleAX, HoleAY, HoleBX, and HoleBY (StringList, each ordered H01 through H04); MachinedRevision (String, B only); RevisionBPart (Link); and RevisionBHoles (LinkList containing H01 through H04). Populate it from the two source documents so it identifies their exact paths and hashes and records every pocket-size and hole-position change. Create exactly one Path/CAM Job whose model and zero-extension stock are Revision B only, with exactly two active native operations in this order: Revision B Pocket followed by Revision B Drilling. Use T1 as a standard FreeCAD D8 mm flat end mill for the B pocket and T2 as a standard FreeCAD D6 mm 118-degree drill for all four B holes. For both tools use forward/clockwise M3 at S7000 rpm and horizontal and vertical feeds of F500 mm/min. The pocket toolpath must stay within the correct D8 cutter-center limits, fully clear the machinable 72 x 44 mm B pocket through valid depth layers to absolute Z=10, and never use A's 60 x 36 limits. The drilling operation must use exactly the four B coordinates to absolute Z=4 and never drill an A-only coordinate. Use G54, safe and clearance heights above Z=18, and the stock LinuxCNC postprocessor. Reasonable native Pocket Shape strategies are allowed when they produce the required bounded coverage; G81, G82, or G83 and G98 or G99 are allowed for drilling when their parameters preserve these locations, depths, and safe retraction. Save the editable document and matching native program exactly as /home/user/Desktop/task-16_B.FCStd and /home/user/Desktop/task-16_B.nc.
